object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: In a repository, (a) acknowledge a suspect link without committing and read its state; (b) leave a link in the working copy with no acknowledged commit while the latest commit holds the link with one; (c) delete a committed target's object file from the working copy without committing, read the state, then restore the file. Expected: (a) the link reads OK before any commit; (b) the link reads suspect with the reason never reviewed; (c) the link reads broken while the file is missing and suspect once it is restored.
